meta.description: A proxy between queues for quevu, in Go: a forwarder (a persistent consumer of a hub that guarantees its own queue on disk and sends small packets) and a receiver (a component mountable on any HTTP mux that feeds what arrives into hubs). Component level only: the transport, its protection and authentication are not decided here. Use when working with github.com/pablo-botella/quevu-forward (package qforward) or when a log has to reach a hub on another machine.
